item.description:
## What's New - Added Retry and Show in Log to links that could not be analyzed - Added a short note to Download options when an AV1 or VP9 video may not play in some media players - Added a frame rate option to Convert - Added the source video codec beside the Off option in Re-encode
## Changed - Improved downloads and conversions to keep their temporary files in the app's own folder, so the output folder only shows the finished file - Changed the wording of four tooltips and accessibility labels - Changed the wording of the format and re-encode tooltips
## Fixes - Fixed Convert overwriting a finished file when the same file is converted again - Fixed failed conversions leaving a partial file in the output folder - Fixed plain text without spaces, such as Japanese words, being accepted as a link - Fixed a crash when adding a folder from the output folder picker - Fixed the resize placeholder not matching the status box, footer, legend and queue rows - Fixed the bottom bar sitting lower than the bottom of the sidebar - Fixed the log showing a "File not found" error after cancelling a download
